Role Purpose

Improve FWA customer base health by identifying retention risks, supporting payment recovery and executing approved customer lifecycle interventions.

Scope of Work

1. Base Monitoring — Review customer cohorts, active-use trends, payment status and early churn patterns.

2. Risk Segmentation — Identify newly active, low-usage or overdue customers requiring targeted follow-up.

3. Retention Execution — Run approved outreach, rebuy and save initiatives with national base management.

4. 5G Adoption — Support customer education and usage expansion where eligible.

5. Lifecycle Requests — Coordinate renewals, relocation or device-related processes with service teams.

6. Performance Feedback — Track cohort survivability, retention results and campaign effectiveness.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Experience in customer lifecycle management, retention or telecom operations.
• Base analytics; campaign execution; customer segmentation; escalation. Strong spreadsheet, presentation and reporting literacy appropriate to the role.
• Ownership and follow-through; clear communication; collaboration across functions; analytical problem-solving; customer and commercial orientation. Leadership and decision complexity should be assessed in proportion to actual role scope.
• Understanding of Agentic AI capabilities and their practical application in customer engagement, retention strategies, campaign optimization, and operational processes.

Job Summary

Assist and perform maintenance daily activities to ensure maintenance work instructions are performed technically correct and in a safe efficient manner; and assist in development and preventative measures, for repeat or ongoing failure trends within relevant department areas, to ensure all activities are conform with company’s standar and policies.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Responsible for compliance to weekly and monthly planning, including scheduled work orders, relating to all maintenance tasks set out daily / to help achieve long term maintenance plans and high equipment availability.
The long term maintenance plans and high equipment availability are successfully achieved.

Monitor and communicate all maintenance work instructions to direct subordinates, in a clear and defined manner.
Maintenance work instructions are monitored and communicated in a clear and defined manner.

Prepare and submit relevant reporting tasks required in a timely manner, for examples: review and ensure correct details on work orders and regularly submit to planners for closing, ensure backlog parts are ordered.
Relevant reporting tasks required are prepared and submitted in a timely manner.

Review and analyse Failures to plant by monitoring trends and report pending equipment failure for correct planning into backlog, advising immediately if equipment is unsafe to operate or high potential of major failure occurring.
Failures are successfully corrected and prevented.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Bachelor's Degree of Engineering

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 1 year experiences particularly in Heavy/Mobile maintenance strategy.
• Experienced with Asset Key Performance Indicator, measurement and analysis.
• Excellent knowledge and technical of Heavy/Mobile Equipment and Maintenance operation.
• Strong knowledge and experience of Repair and Maintenance Methodology and Analysis as well as by using kind of tools analysis
• Strong knowledge Cost and Capital Engineering.
• Good understanding of mining requirements and production targets
• Fluent in English, both
spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior
